pendentes.titulo: RTX Spark: notebooks Windows com chip Nvidia chegam dia 16
pendentes.alt: Notebook fino e aberto sobre uma mesa de trabalho, visto de lado, ao lado de um caderno e uma xícara
pendentes.pedido: A thin generic silver laptop open on a wooden work desk, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle so the screen is not visible. Beside it, a closed plain paper notebook with a pen and a plain ceramic coffee cup. Soft natural daylight from a window, home office background out of focus.
